# SEC-004: A local HTTP server listens on loopback only

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| warn | both eras, http | [2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http#security--endpoint](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http#security--endpoint) |

When the server URL is on this machine (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1), tries to open a TCP connection to the same port on this machine's network address. When running locally, servers SHOULD bind only to localhost (127.0.0.1) rather than all network interfaces (0.0.0.0); otherwise anything on the network can reach the server. Skipped for remote servers and on machines without a network address. Origin validation is CONF-007; a request without an Origin header is not flagged, because non-browser clients never send one. Runs once per server.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain SEC-004`. To leave it out of a run, add `"SEC-004"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
